queries.list: select "browsers"."id", "browsers"."project_id", "browsers"."protected_label", "browsers"."protected_state", "browsers"."state_revision", "browsers"."position", "browsers"."created_at", "browsers"."updated_at", "remote_surfaces"."worker_id" from "browsers" inner join "projects" on ("projects"."id" = "browsers"."project_id" and "projects"."owner_id" = $1) left join "remote_surfaces" on "remote_surfaces"."id" = "browsers"."id" where "browsers"."project_id" = $2 order by "browsers"."position" asc, "browsers"."created_at" asc
queries.owned: select "browsers"."id" from "browsers" inner join "projects" on ("projects"."id" = "browsers"."project_id" and "projects"."owner_id" = $1) where "browsers"."id" = $2 limit $3
queries.create: insert into "browsers" ("id", "project_id", "protected_label", "protected_state", "state_revision", "position", "created_at", "updated_at") values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, default, default) returning "id", "project_id", "protected_label", "protected_state", "state_revision", "position", "created_at", "updated_at"
